test_title: PYST 36: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 190 735 494 761 781 (Right)

(Example-697 - First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7) (NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the second digit of the highest number is subtracted from the second digit of the lowest number?
solution:
As per the question,

Given Numbers: 190 735 494 761 781

Rule: Subtract the second digit of the highest number from the second digit of the lowest number.

→ Lowest number: 190

→ Second digit of the lowest number: 9

→ Highest number: 781

→ Second digit of the highest number: 8

So, required answer = 9 - 8 = 1

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
